name: How much does drywall patching usually cost?
description: Price depends on hole size, texture matching, and painting. Small cosmetic patches cost far less than large repairs or water-damage fixes.

mainEntity.name: How much does drywall patching usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the size of the damage, whether texture matching is needed, and whether painting is included. Small cosmetic fixes are usually much cheaper than replacing a larger section, especially if the repair also has to address water damage or framing issues.
